topics.title: equipment loan extension
topics.rule: Borrowed laboratory devices can be kept for six extra days after a supervisor signs an extension request.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for equipment loan extension.

topics.title: equipment loss replacement
topics.rule: If a borrowed laboratory device is lost, the borrower submits a replacement voucher. An extension form cannot settle a missing device.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for equipment loss replacement.

topics.title: meeting room cancellation notice
topics.rule: A reserved meeting room can be cancelled without a charge until noon two business days before the meeting.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for meeting room cancellation notice.

topics.title: meeting room damage charge
topics.rule: Damage to a reserved meeting room is charged after a staff inspection. Cancelling the reservation does not remove a damage charge.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for meeting room damage charge.

topics.title: travel advance reconciliation
topics.rule: An employee settles money received before a business trip by submitting itemized receipts within eleven days after returning.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for travel advance reconciliation.

topics.title: travel expense preapproval
topics.rule: Before buying travel tickets with personal money, an employee obtains written authorization from the budget owner. Receipts alone do not replace prior authorization.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for travel expense preapproval.

topics.title: archive collection delegate
topics.rule: A named representative can collect a physical archive parcel with a collection slip registered by its requester.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for archive collection delegate.

topics.title: archive destruction consent
topics.rule: A paper archive is destroyed only after written consent from its records owner. A collection slip cannot authorize destruction.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for archive destruction consent.
